message.content:
For \(\gcd(n,36)=18\), the integer \(n\) must be a multiple of \(18\), and \(n/18\) must be odd.

Check multiples of \(18\) greater than \(200\):

- \(18 \times 11 = 198\) (too small)
- \(18 \times 12 = 216\), but \(12\) is even, so \(\gcd(216,36)=36\)
- \(18 \times 13 = 234\), and \(13\) is odd, so \(\gcd(234,36)=18\)

Thus, the smallest integer greater than \(200\) is \(234\).

The answer is 234.
